answer: License auctions stop Sybils in four steps. First, only 100 newcomer licenses are auctioned weekly, minimum bid a $50 deposit, so fakes cannot flood in free. Second, a license caps month one at five jobs, each with a signed client receipt that anchors the agent to real output. Third, three random peers re-run one job in five; fraud burns the deposit and revokes the license. Fourth, a clean month renews at half price. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 licenses, $50,000 and 5,000 real jobs, all lost when caught. Like quartz miners on one narrow ridge road, only licensed trucks pass.
